listings.rawTitle: Byredo Mojave Ghost L'Huile Parfum Roll-On Perfumed Oil, 7.5ml
listings.description: Roll-On Perfumed Oil delivers an intense hit of fragrance with a long-lasting effect, in an alcohol-free formulation. Housed in a travel-friendly glass vial, perfect for on-the-go application. Capturing the soulful beauty of the Mojave Desert, this scent draws on the rare ghost flowers that emerge amidst the arid wilderness. Fragile, translucent petals blooming atop sunbaked terrain: a miraculous moment of life in Death Valley. Delicate magnolia and powdery violet notes layered atop the hazy warmth of ambrette and cedarwood. Against a seductive landscape of musk, a fresh appearance of Jamaican Nesberry. A graceful, lingering spirit of slowly unfurling contrasts. Notes: Top: Ambrette Heart: Magnolia, Sandalwood, Violet Base: Cedarwood, Chantilly Musk, Crisp Amber

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu Eau de Parfum Limited Edition Sleeve, 100ml
listings.description: The ambery COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU scent embodies the power of attraction, whose pull is impossible to resist. An Eau de Parfum whose intensity is magnetic, designed by CHANEL In-House Perfumer-Creator Olivier Polge. It sparks a liberating rush each time it is applied, like love at first sight. COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU disrupts the status quo, presenting a sensual, captivating and indescribable version of femininity by means of fruity, floral and woody-ambery accords. A scent that leaves no one indifferent. COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU has taken the iconic COCO MADEMOISELLE bottle and elevated its impact and power of attraction to the next level. The scent's colour, a more intense variation of the line's hallmark pink-beige hue, evokes a deep, almost visceral sensuality. The black label accentuates the bottle's mystique. The CRUSH ABSOLU name appears in golden lettering, set into the glass like the promise of forever. Each detail strengthens the fragrance's magnetic pull and arouses fascination. How to use: To bring out the full power of this magnetic fragrance, spray COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Eau de Parfum onto the skin or inside clothing in a sweeping motion. To accentuate the scent's sensual nature, spray it on the pulse points: the décolleté, the nape of the neck and the wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: To mark its sixtieth anniversary, Diptyque has chosen to pay homage to the legendary encounter with Orphéon, a late-night bar at the intersection of 34 boulevard Saint-Germain and the Rue de Pontoise. The bar’s entrance was adjacent to the original Diptyque boutique, and a few years later the Maison has extended into its space. Today, the only remaining vestige from the Orphéon is the blue faceted column at the back of the Diptyque boutique at 34 boulevard Saint-Germain. Orphéon Eau de Parfum is the olfactory portrait of the place where curls of tobacco smoke mingle with powdery trails of blusher, lingering on burnished wood. At the heart of the composition is the atmosphere of that unforgettable place, recognisable through the warmth of the tonka bean, the depth of cedar and the vivacity of juniper berries.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL N°5 Eau de Parfum Purse Spray, 3 x 20ml
listings.description: N°5, the very essence of femininity. A powdery floral bouquet housed in an iconic bottle with a minimalist design. A timeless, legendary fragrance. The eau de parfum draws inspiration from the parfum with which it shares its floral aldehyde signature. This floral bouquet composed around May Rose and Jasmine features bright citrus top notes. Aldehydes create a unique presence, and the smooth touch of Vanilla an incredibly sensual trail.20 ml spray sold with 2 refills.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Neroli Amara Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: The Collection Extraordinaire’s new Opus presents an emblematic material in perfumery: Neroli. Floral, green, and citrusy all at once, Neroli breathes new air into the Collection, making it more aqueous and botanical. The fragrance of Neroli Amara tells the tale of a princess’s love for her flower, Amara Orange Blossom… Notes: Top - Lemon Italy, Mandarin, Bergamot Middle - Black Pepper, Cypress Base - Orange Blossom Absolute

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: In ancient Greece, one myth stood out as the most passionate and sensual: the love between Psyche and Eros. Only one scent can convey this legend as a fragrance, that of musks. Equally legendary, they have the unique ability to enhance the skin with their arousing carnal accents. They are at the very heart of Fleur de Peau, as cottony and light as they are soft. Highlighted with the elegantly powdery iris and fruity, ambery ambrette seeds, they reveal their full tactile dimension.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum Twist and Spray
listings.description: The essence of a bold, free woman. An Amber fragrance with a strong personality, yet surprisingly fresh. The eau de parfum comes in a "Twist And Spray" format you can slip into your purse. A simple twist envelops you in the modern notes of this Amber-fresh fragrance. An Amber fragrance with a strong personality, yet surprisingly fresh. Sparks of fresh and vibrant orange immediately awaken the senses. A clear and sensual heart reveals the transparent accords of Jasmine and Rose. The trail unfurls the pure accents of Patchouli and Vetiver that emphasise the slender structure of the composition. The eau de parfum comes in a purse spray format to revive the notes of the fragrance throughout the day. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is also available to enhance the fragrance trail.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Sauvage Extrait, 50ml
listings.description: A men's fragrance icon and true to its pioneering spirit, Sauvage Extrait is Dior's first extrait de parfum for men. A composition of unprecedented intensity, matured for 42 days to reach its peak of intensity, resulting in ultimate long-lasting wear and power. The beating heart of the composition, the precious essence of Vietnamese oud, leaves its animalic imprint with leather notes in a rich blend of noble woods. In this denser and more woody interpretation, Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, imagined this intense trail that pushes the limits of concentration. The dark and enveloping essence of Indonesian patchouli contrasts with the light, creamy essences of Madagascan vetiver and Virginia cedarwood. A sensual and powerful base that is contrasted by a fresh and aromatic top accord of bergamot and an essence of AOP lavender from Provence. Its bottle, with its translucent interior lacquer – a true masterpiece of glasswork – evokes a drop of deep blue ink suspended in crystalline glass, engraved with the CD monogram. A signature that also adorns the cap, like a crown on the bottle. How to use: Spray Sauvage Extrait on pulse points, wrists and neck, to reveal a powerful and long-lasting olfactory imprint on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Bois Impérial by Quentin Bisch Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Bois Impérial has freshly crushed and spicy Thai Basil leaves that meet the sparkling peppery and grapefruit facets of Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute. A brilliant combination that contrasts perfectly with the bold woody signature of the fragrance. A green, rich and earthy Haitian Vetiver oil echoes with Georgywood, an exclusive molecule with powerful cedarwood tones. This vibrating woody association is illuminated by the sophisticated floralcy of Petalia. The majestic Akigalawood truly signs the fragrance. This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from Patchouli through a biotechnology process. Its unique spicy-woody character is enhanced by a rich Indonesian Patchouli oil and a powerful, sustainable note of Ambrofix.

listings.rawTitle: CREED Men's Sample Inspiration Fragrance Gift Set, 5 x 1.7ml

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Allure Homme Sport Superleggera Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A new interpretation of the ALLURE HOMME SPORT fragrance, available as a limited-edition release. ALLURE HOMME SPORT SUPERLEGGERA is an intense fragrance with fresh, woody, ambery notes. A work of precision and balance that has been tuned to perfection. A tension between lightness and intensity, which reveals the allure of a man who is free and who strives for the ultimate in performance. Sleek and compact with a streamlined shape, the iconic ALLURE HOMME SPORT bottle has been reimagined using clear smoked glass. The emblematic Superleggera name, a symbol of excellence and distinction, is stamped in raised red lettering on the bottle, adding a touch of sporty allure. How to use: Spray ALLURE HOMME SPORT SUPERLEGGERA on skin or inside clothing.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Crafted Collection Rosetopia Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The soft texture of petals and fresh notes of florals. LOEWE Rosetopia Eau de Parfum is a captivating fresh rose fragrance, conceived as a niche perfume that connects the human spirit with the raw beauty of nature. LOEWE Rosetopia Eau de Parfum is a contemporary olfactory escape shaped through notes of grapefruit and pink pepper, balanced by the delicacy of peony and lily of the valley. This nuanced peony perfume evokes pure serenity. Damascene rose forms the heart of the composition, unfolding into a base of amber and amber musk. Unveiling a deeply comforting amber scent, this niche fragrance lingers beautifully on the skin. The resinous, ambery LOEWE Accord waves through the composition. Inspired by the organic beauty of traditional handblown glass, this fresh fragrance from the LOEWE Crafted Collection arrives in a sculptural glass flask topped with a tactile granite cap, celebrating the collection’s innate artistry. A sensorial ode to floral notes, LOEWE Rosetopia EDP stands as a refined expression of craft.

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Oh! Midsummar Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: A scent of sunlight and celebration. Fresh wild strawberries glisten against green stems and meadow dew. Buttercups, clover, cornflower and meadowsweet weave the scent of flower crowns and birch-dressed maypoles. Gentle jasmine adds a soft, sunlit radiance, while patchouli and musk bring warmth and the feeling of skin in the open air. Scent notes: Top: Buttercup Accord Middle: Wild Strawberry Accord Base: Orcanox™ (captive ingredient)

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Distant Shores Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Empty beaches and shimmering horizons. Sea lily and sea grass ripple in the wind, touched by samphire and the faint salt of skin after a swim. Heather drifts through the air in a soft floral haze, while sun-warmed driftwood settles gently beneath it. Rolling sand dunes hold back the breeze, guarding quiet, summertime secrets. Scent notes: Top: Fresh Crisp Air Accord, Arctic Thyme Accord Middle: Mountain Carnation Accord, Olibanum Resinoid Base: Birch Tree Skin Accord, Moss Accord

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Deep Forest Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: A meditative walk beneath the pine canopy, where the air tastes of resin and rain. Pine needles and fir balsam bring crisp clarity, while cedar, spruce and vetiver root the scent in earthy calm. A breath of forest air accord moves through the stillness, carrying the brightness of pink pepper, rowanberry and juniper, like wild berries scattered across the forest floor. Scent notes: Top: Eucalyptus Leaves Essential Oil, Pink Pepper Pure Essence™ (captive ingredient) Middle: Cypress Essential Oil, Pine Essential Oil Base: Vetiver Essential Oil, Cedarwood Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Nordik Nights Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Outside, snow falls in silence; inside, warmth lingers. A scent that captures the sensual side of hygge, when soft light, stillness and comfort turn into deeper connection. Scent notes: Top: Cappuccino Accord Middle: Tonka Bean Absolute, Danish Bakery Accord Base: Driftwood Accord, Cedarwood Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Kopenhagen Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Climbing white roses open to the cool city air, merging with the soft mineral scent of stone after rain. Along the harbour, water moss mingles with a metallic accord of polished steel, reflecting the blend of ancient trading hub and modern creative pulse. Beneath the freshness, a trace of charred wood and pale musks adds warmth and depth in a contrast of purity and texture. Scent notes: Top: Blue aluminium Accord Middle: Cypress Essential Oil, Moss Accord Base: Cedarwood Essential Oil, Gaiacwood Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Erotika Minimale Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Embody the essence of subtle sensuality. Erotika Minimale by New Notes is an aphrodisiac oriental-gourmand fragrance that celebrates the power of understated allure and confident elegance. It opens with an intriguing aura of warm spices, transitioning into a sophisticated, powdery floral heart before settling into a captivating base of leathery patchouli and soft vanilla nuances. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Spicy Coriander, Warm Cinnamon Heart notes: Pulpy Geranium, Powdery Rose, Sophisticated Iris, Jasmine Base notes: Sensual Musk, Leathery Patchouli, Warm Amber, Soft Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Argentina Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: With Argentina, Memo plunges into the heart of a territory, a country, to the rhythm of a dance, a passionate impulse. Argentina is embraced in its entirety, carried away in a single movement; that of a twirling tango. A dance of mixing, of travel, and on the dance floor, corolla shapes appear. Like a rose, emblematic of perfume, queen of flowers and symbol of ardent love. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Pink Pepper CO2 extract, Ambrette absolute Heart notes: Rose absolute, Jasmine Sambac absolute, Magnolia essence Base notes: Oud essence, Cypriol Heart, Benzoin resinoid Siam

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Blanc Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: In the world of Soleil, the sun never sets. The heat of endless summer lingers on the skin and wears long into the night. Soleil Blanc Parfum is an exaltation of floral-amber warmth with a rich concentration of white florals and glowing vanilla absolute. TOM FORD Soleil Blanc Parfum is a heightened blend of white florals, amber and coco de mer accord. The Soleil Blanc Parfum bottle embodies the uninhibited pursuit of sun and luxury with a bright white lacquered bottle and golden accents. The Parfum features an elevated, bevelled cap and plaque. Fragrance family: Warm and Spicy Scent type: Amber Floral

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Limited Edition Colonia Il Profumo Millesimato, 100ml
listings.description: To mark the 110th anniversary of Acqua di Parma’s Italian Art of Living, Colonia Il Profumo is reimagined in a celebratory Millesimato limited edition that magnifies its citrus notes and enduring Italian elegance. At its heart lies the exceptional 2024 harvest of Ylang-Ylang from Nosy Be, cultivated in the Madagascan island’s tropical climate, where the flowers develop their full complexity, marked by fruity and subtly spiced undertones. Nurtured by the year’s rare convergence of abundant rainfall and gentle warmth, the flower reveals a rare luminous complexity and intensity. Expertly distilled over 24 hours and delicately fractionated, the 2024 harvest of Ylang-Ylang from Nosy Be amplifies the vibrancy of the citruses and gives density and depth to the perfume. Italian bergamot, blood orange, petitgrain, and grapefruit open the composition with a golden freshness, while rosemary, orange leaves absolute, patchouli, and vetiver give structure and sophistication to this citrus aromatic creation. Presented in a glass bottle with an embossed architectural detail inspired by classical Italian design and a back label that highlights the fragrance’s craftsmanship and olfactory composition, the fragrance is housed in Acqua di Parma’s iconic yellow hatbox, distinguished by a golden medal stamp celebrating the 2024 harvest and the 110th anniversary of Acqua di Parma. A collector’s icon that bridges heritage and modern refinement with sophisticated olfactive clarity.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Tropiques Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Tropiques is a charismatic elixir for the bold explorer and a delicious ode to the lush flora found in the equatorial reaches of our wondrous planet. It is an exploration of the beauty of the tropics and their tantalising treasures. Created by perfumer Gael Montero, the fragrance starts with a vibrant infusion of bergamot, mandarin and papaya that ignites the senses, before they mingle with a sumptuously sweet rosyfolia®, lavandin and mahonial® in the heart. The ground-breaking captive molecules reinvent the story of exotic blooms, creating a drift of soft, solar floral heart notes caught on an island breeze. A dry-down of caramel, amber and musk evokes the warm embrace of the sun on the sand at the day’s close, rounding out this Fruity-Amber perfume that dances on the skin like sunlight and is your passport to an unspoilt, far-away island paradise.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Violet & Amber Absolu, 100ml
listings.description: In the Arabian night, an ethereal violet mysteriously blooms. Beloved of the British flower bed, its elusive scent of darkly purple petals and violet leaves wraps around oud and white musk, anchored by warm, sophisticated amber. Fragrance notes: Heart notes: Violet. A smooth, warm and enveloping accord, composed of violet leaf and violet petals. Powdery and elegant Base notes: Amber. A note that wraps the fragrance in woody warmth, imbuing it with sensuality How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points. Your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Psychedelic Love Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: The signature of this narcotic bomb lies in three essential ingredients: Rose, Hedione and Heliotropin. Equally tender and illicit, this crystalline powder hides its intentions well. Beware of its creamy, powdery and floral facets, wavering between Vanilla and Almond! Floral. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Bergamot, Rose, Myrrh, Vanilla, Patchouli, Heliotrope, Hedione.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Vanille Leather Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Vanille Leather honours vanilla, a precious spice from Madagascar, in a creation with voluptuous and textured tones. Majestic, it invites you on an olfactory journey between warmth and sensuality. It melts into a trilogy of Indian tuberose, Egyptian jasmine and orange blossom.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Iris Malikhân Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by a breathtaking discovery of iris fields on the edge of the desert, Iris Malikhân contrasts a powdery verdant iris with warm notes of vanilla and leather. An intoxicating and addictive creation! Fragrance notes: Cypress essential oil, lentisque essential oil, galbanum absolute, orris butter, mimosa absolute, vanilla, leather accord, amber, musks. A fragrance for women and men.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Ambre Latte by Jordi Fernández Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Ambre Latte opens in a vaporous cloud of almond milk infused with roasted tonka bean. A decadent dulce de leche caramel melts into vanilla, benzoin and white musks, creating a perfectly controlled indulgence. Beneath its milky caress emerges a woody-amber alchemy, where Ambrofix, Georgywood, Akigalawood and sandalwood shape an intensely addictive trail, the perfect balance between gourmandise and addiction.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The new feminine fragrance by Miu Miu - a duo of wild strawberry accord with vanilla and brown sugar twists an iconic warm floral signature with a hint of gourmand. Unconstrained and unconventionally feminine, Miutine Eau de Parfum reaffirms the essence of Miu Miu with a bold, memorable scent for those who navigate life on their own terms. Fragrance notes: Top note: Wild Strawberry accord Heart note: Gardenia accord Base note: Brown Sugar accord, Vanilla, Patchouli oil Youthful and unconstrained, Miutine offers a Miu Miu twist on an iconic fragrance family: the warm floral. Inspired by Miuccia Prada’s unconventional aesthetic, master perfumer Dominique Ropion teases the vintage genre into an effortlessly cool floral with a gourmand twist that subverts expectations. "I started from a classic and I twisted it with a surprising resonance, a harmony of mischievous freshness and opulent sensuality." Dominique Ropion, master perfumer of Miutine. Miutine Eau de Parfum is the signature Miu Miu fragrance for those who are confident in their contradictions. Featuring juicy wild strawberry to express the Miu Miu girl’s spontaneous and unyielding spirit. A radiant, milky gardenia accord to embody her effortless charm. A sweetly provocative blend of chic patchouli oil, brown sugar accord, and vanilla for her unconventional femininity. Cheeky but sophisticated. Youthful yet assertive. Irreverent and carefree. About the bottle: Twisted into a modern icon for Miutine, Miu Miu’s signature retro-modern bottle becomes more covetable than ever. Irreverent and sophisticated, with the famous matelassé glass inspired by the luxury house’s iconic leather handbags. Instantly desirable, with the Miu Miu tag as a ring around the collar. Bold and playful, with its round black cap in the shape of a sequin. The unexpected modern brown tint of the transparent glass expresses a different, ultra-contemporary type of femininity, with a touch of boyishness. Youthful as ever. But all grown up. How to use: Exude the carefree spirit of a Miu Miu girl with your new signature scent - spray Miutine to the pulse points on your neck, collarbone, and wrist. To leave an even longer-lasting scent trail, apply to the crooks of your elbows and the back of the knees, which will intensify the fragrance with the warmth of your body heat.

listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Liquidum stage: Gucci Fiori di Neroli Eau de Parfum. The sparkling soul of a Mediterranean breeze, distilled. Floral, Wood, Sparkling. Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus. Featuring Italian Neroli Essential Oil exclusively sourced with one of the last Neroli producers in Italy. The 7th generation Liguria terroir producer utilizes artisanal in-house distillation to transform the raw ingredient. Steam extracts their essence, transforming it into a precious oil. The Gucci fragrance is grounded with Cedarwood notes and elevated with the green, fresh scent of Petitgrain, showcasing the transformative powers of water and the mastery of the ultimate alchemist’s technique: distillation. The bottle: A gold bottle reminiscent of the golden Neroli Essential Oil extracted through the transformative powers of water. The bottle’s orange blossom bud symbol tells the story of reviving this quintessential Italian tradition. Olfactive alchemists: Gucci olfactive alchemists Mathieu Nardin and Julie Massé separate the essence of Neroli to capture the traditional scent’s golden soul in various ways. How to use: |To enjoy the addictive notes of this Gucci perfume for longer, it is recommended to apply it to the body’s pulse points, including the wrists, neck, behind the ears and chest Designed to be layered with other fragrances, create your own unique scent with other products from the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection. There are three recommended layering combinations for Gucci Fiori di Neroli Eau de Parfum: Combined with Vanilla Firenze Eau de Parfum to unveil a zested vanilla, where Neroli, Italian Orris, and Vanilla create a creamy violet citrus For a creamy citrus scent, layer Fiori di Neroli with Osmanthus Nectar Eau de Parfum, as Osmanthus Nectar and Neroli burst with a deliciously fruity trail Enhance Fiori di Neroli by pairing it with Fading Autumn perfumed water and A Nocturnal Whisper perfumed oil, where Neroli, Woods, and Oud whisper between the forests and orchards

An unexpected juxtaposition, an olfactory translation of the Venetian terrazzo’s compositional technique, in which precious materials such as gold, marble and Murano glass are combined with mastery to create an objet d’art. A touch of flowers shines through the essential oils of orange blossom, jasmine sambac and geranium, further enhancing the heart of the composition. The woody and amber notes of tonka bean and vanilla soften the dusky accents of saffron, creating an intriguing and unexpected harmony. An exquisite experience that unfolds over time. A radiant interpretation of the precious and soft scent of Saffron. Ambery Woody. listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Baie 19 Eau de Parfum Travel Refill, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Truth is...Baie 19 should have been called Water 19. Not that it smells like nothing (though nothing smells like it), but it has this crisp, wet, drenched effect that water gives to the earth after the rain...And there’s a word for that, by the way: petrichor. It’s that magical feeling during heavy rain after a long dry spell, and it’s one of the most beautiful olfactive phenomena in nature. There are many reasons for this, including the ozone in the air, the negative ions, but most importantly the release of oil secretions from certain plants, accumulated after a long dry period. This is what Baie 19 is about: the dry juniper berry, the patchouli, the green leaves... all soaked by a beautiful, luminous, magnetic rain after a long drought. And the joy that comes with it... Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani unveils Armani Code Eau de Parfum, a new compelling and vibrant intensity, encapsulated in the iconic Armani Code refillable bottle. A new fougère ambery spicy fragrance that opens with a faceted freshness with notes of green mandarin and unfolds into a spicy and woody heart of nutmeg essence. A masculine sensuality emerges from the fragrance’s base through a rich and warm tonka bean absolute. Armani Code Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh and vibrant green mandarin essence, sourced from Italy, which brings a distinctive tangy effect to the fragrance. This essence is obtained by grating the zest of the mandarin fruit under running water, with the essence then separated from the water. The heart of the fragrance is composed of a warm and spicy nutmeg essence. The nutmeg essence, derived from the fruit of the nutmeg trees, is obtained via a meticulous drying and steam distillation process, to create its warm, spicy, and woody note. A warm, sensual masculinity is revealed in the fragrance’s base notes, which spotlight the richness of tonka bean absolute. Creating a honeyed tobacco note with milky undertones, the tonka bean absolute is derived from the fruit of the Dipterix odorata tree. The fruits are harvested just as they fall from the tree and undergo a drying process to allow the development of the coumarin molecule, that lends tonka its scent. The absolute is then obtained using a solvent extraction method. How to use: Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long-lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.
